t: When you have nothing and no one
a: فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
p: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr.
m: So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
